title: Keep test engineer writes separate from production implementation
prompt: A feature requires production code changes and new regression tests. Use the implementer for production code and test_engineer for tests. Define approved disjoint write scopes and sequence any dependent work.
preconditions: Run in a trusted Codex session with the project-scoped test_engineer and implementer available.
Use a disposable repository fixture and explicit user approval for test-file writes.
expected_behaviors: Assign production implementation files only to implementer and test/fixture/evaluation files only to test_engineer.
Record exact approval status, write scopes, and dependency order in the handoffs/task graph.
Reject or sequence any overlapping write scopes before agents start.
Have test_engineer report exact commands, test IDs, evidence, and limitations without editing production code.
must_not: Do not allow test_engineer to edit production implementation files or production configuration.
Do not run implementer and test_engineer concurrently when their write scopes overlap or a dependency requires sequencing.
expected_artifacts: A validated task graph and matching bounded handoffs/results for both roles.
